verdict.rationale: Persona Workflows let users define trigger-based automations. Every workflow begins with a trigger, and workflows can automatically tag high-risk inquiries or run additional reports when specific conditions are met. Cases also supports creating automations, so the core of the story (rules, event triggers, automatic actions) is documented first-party. Missing for 10: an enumerated list of trigger and event types and the full action catalog, evidence of programmatic or AI-native rule definition, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
